name: Three-Lobe Bracket (AutoCAD 2017 exercise, OIP-652393864)
origin: Origin (0,0) is the center of the large hub C1 (the Oe40 OD / Oe20 bore boss at the upper right of the part). All coordinates are in this frame.
axes: +X to the right, +Y up (standard CAD/math orientation). Angles are degrees, measured CCW from +X. The drawing's horizontal dash-dot centerline through C1 is the X axis; the vertical dash-dot centerline through C1 is the Y axis. Part lies in the XY plane and is extruded along +Z.

params.no_thickness_callout: There is NO thickness dimension anywhere on this drawing. It is a single top (plan) view only - no section, no side view, no title-block thickness note.
params.image_resolution_px: 474x266 (screenshot of AutoCAD beside Paint 3D); drawing occupies roughly x=208..470, y=30..258 of the right pane

params.role: Datum feature. This is a free-standing annular ring: the outer profile does NOT follow the Ø40 circle. The Ø40 circle is a real edge, and the outer boundary passes tangentially just outside/over it via the two R30 arcs.
params.verified: Both circles measured concentric; OD spans 52.5 px => 40 mm at 0.762 mm/px.

params.center_x_source: EXACT - the '10' linear dimension is a horizontal offset between the vertical centerline of C1 and the vertical centerline of C2. Measured -10.29 mm (scale 0.762) / -9.51 mm (scale 0.786). C2 is 10 mm to the LEFT of C1.
params.center_y_source: NOT directly dimensioned. Derived: measured -62.1 mm (scale 0.762) and -64.1 mm (scale 0.786); independently confirmed by the R32 tangency solution, which reproduces the measured R32 tangent point to 32.4 vs 32.0 nominal. Adopted -62.0.
params.center_y_confidence: (est) - implied by tangency, not by an explicit callout
params.role: Second lobe. Its Ø50 outer circle IS part of the outer profile: the boundary runs along the Ø50 arc between the R32 fillet (upper left) and the R25 fillet (right).
params.correction: The supplied context value C2=(-10,-48.3) is WRONG in Y. 48.3 would put the boss far too close to C1 and breaks the R32/R25 tangency. Correct Y is approximately -62.

params.axis_angle_equivalent: 315 deg CCW from +X; equals 135 deg measured clockwise from +X; equals the 135° callout measured from the -X horizontal centerline at C3 sweeping clockwise/down to the axis.
params.dimension_chain: 60 and 30 are CHAINED aligned (parallel) dimensions along the same -45° diagonal: 60 runs C1 -> near cap center; 30 continues from the near cap center -> far cap center. Their extension lines are perpendicular to the -45° axis.
params.angle_datum: The 135° angular dimension is centered at the FAR cap center (C3 far, where the dash-dot centerlines cross). Leg 1 = the horizontal centerline running in the -X direction. Leg 2 = the slot axis running down-right at -45°. 180° - 45° = 135°.
params.measured_verification: Cap-to-cap measured 30.83 mm (nominal 30). Axis angle measured -46.1° and -45.1° in two independent crops (nominal -45°). Transverse width measured 13.97 mm => cap R ≈ 7.0 (nominal R8).
params.role: IMPORTANT - this obround is the OUTER BOUNDARY of the third lobe, drawn in heavy/continuous linework. It is NOT an internal slot cut. It is an external stadium-shaped ear.
params.resolution_of_ambiguity_b: Orientation = axis along -45° (down and to the right from C1). Position = near cap center at 60 mm from C1 along that -45° ray, i.e. (42.426, -42.426); far cap 30 mm further at (63.64, -63.64). NOT centered at a point 'C3' - the 30 is a center-to-center length, so the geometric midpoint is (53.033, -53.033).
params.correction: Supplied context C3=(+46.2,-46.2) gives 65.34 mm from C1, contradicting the dimensioned 60. Use (42.426,-42.426) for the near cap. Also, the context described S2 as a slot 'centered at C3' - it is actually the outer lobe boundary, and the 30 is cap-center to cap-center.

params.type_detail: Arc-shaped (curved) through slot with radiused ends - the only genuine internal slot cut on the part.
params.centerline_center_note: Concentric with C1 (the origin). Confirmed: both cap centers measured at radius 69.3 and 68.9 mm from C1.
params.angle_datum: The 42° angular dimension is centered at C1. Its two legs are radial lines from C1 through the two slot cap centers. The lower leg lands on the horizontal X axis (180°); the upper leg is 42° above it (138°).
params.measured_verification: Upper cap measured at 137.1° / r=69.3; lower cap measured at 178.9° / r=68.9. Span 41.8° vs nominal 42°. Slot width measured 16.05 mm vs nominal 16.
params.correction: The supplied context range '117-159 deg' is WRONG. The correct centerline span is 138° to 180°. The outer R78 / inner R62 / R8 caps in the context ARE correct.

params.topology: A single closed loop made of three lobes joined by tangent arcs. It is an OPEN 3-lobe (tri-star / triskelion) shape - there is NO enclosing disc. Only the C2 Ø50 boss and the C3 obround contribute real boundary arcs; the C1 hub is bridged OVER by the two R30 arcs and its Ø40 circle is a free-standing interior edge.
traversal_order_ccw: 1. ARM OUTER ARC R85 - centered at C1, radius 85, sweeping the arm from about 180° up to about 138° (the same angular band as the S1 slot). This is the far outer edge of the upper-left arm.
2. R30 (upper) - rounds the arm tip / forms the concave valley where the arm's right flank falls away toward the hub.
3. R30 (lower-right) - convex crest arc that rides tangentially OVER the top of the Ø40 hub and turns the boundary onto the straight diagonal flank.

4. STRAIGHT DIAGONAL FLANK - a straight line parallel to the -45° axis, tangent to the R30 crest and running down-right, tangent to the far R8 cap of the obround. The 60 and 30 dimensions are drawn parallel to this flank.
5. OBROUND LOBE - R8 far cap, then back along the obround's lower-left side to the R8 near cap.
6. R25 - concave fillet from the obround near cap sweeping left/down into the Ø50 boss.
7. Ø50 BOSS ARC - the outer profile follows the C2 Ø50 circle around its lower/left side.
8. R32 - large concave fillet sweeping from the Ø50 boss up-left to the lower tip of the arm.
9. R15 - convex rounding of the arm's lower/outer tip, closing back onto the R85 arc.
params.connection_rule: Every junction in the loop is TANGENT (G1 continuous). There are no sharp corners anywhere on the outer profile. Concave (valley) fillets: R30-upper, R25, R32. Convex (crest) arcs: R85, R30-lower-right, R15, and the two R8 obround caps.
params.resolution_of_ambiguity_a: The current model's 'disc R50 + arm wedge + boss + lobe' is wrong. Replace with this open tri-lobe tangent chain. Critically: there is no R50 disc, and the Ø40 hub must be an isolated ring that the boundary passes over, not a filled disc.

params.concentric_with: C1 origin, and with the R70 slot centerline
params.measured_verification: Arm outer edge measured 82.7, 81.9 and 83.7 mm from C1 at three points - consistent with R85 given raster limits.
params.note: Because R85 (outer) and R70 (slot centerline) share center C1, the arm is a constant-width curved band. Material outboard of the slot = 85-78 = 7 mm; inboard = 62 - (inner profile) .

params.location: Upper area, between the arm's right flank and the crest that goes over the hub. This is the dip of the S-curve clearly visible above and left of the Ø40 hub.
params.center_confidence: (est) - derived as lying on the 138° ray at radius 85-30=55; the raster is too coarse to fix it exactly.
params.callout: R30 (the left-hand of the two R30 labels; its leader arrow points into the concave dip)

params.location: Rides tangentially over the top of the Ø40 hub, just right of the hub's vertical centerline, then turns down into the straight -45° diagonal flank.
params.center_derivation: Internally tangent to the Ø40 hub OD: |center - C1| = 30 - 20 = 10, oriented up-and-right (about 70°).
params.center_confidence: (est) - the tangency to Ø40 is clear in the drawing but the exact bearing is not dimensioned.
params.callout: R30 (the right-hand of the two R30 labels; its leader arrow points at the crest just right of the hub top)
params.measured_verification: Leader arrowhead measured landing at about (15.6, 27.4), i.e. up and to the right of the hub - consistent with a crest arc there.

params.center_derivation: Externally tangent to the C2 Ø50 boss (|center-C2| = 25+25 = 50) and to the obround near cap (|center-C3near| = 25+8 = 33). Of the two solutions, this one lies outboard/below the part and produces the observed inward valley.
params.measured_verification: Measured tangent point about (29.3,-59.5) sits 18.0 mm from this center vs 40.7 mm from the rejected alternative - this center is the correct branch.
params.confidence: (est) on the exact center because it inherits C2's undimensioned Y; the R25 value itself is an explicit callout.

params.center_derivation: Externally tangent to the R15 arm-tip arc (|center - (-70,0)| = 15+32 = 47) and to the C2 Ø50 boss (|center - C2| = 25+32 = 57).
params.measured_verification: STRONG - measured R32 tangent point (-39.7,-26.3) lies 32.4 mm from this center vs nominal 32.0 (0.4 mm error). The rejected alternative gave 25.5. This independently corroborates C2 y = -62.
params.note: This is the long sweeping concave edge on the lower left of the part, running from under the arm down to the boss.

params.center_note: Coincident with the S1 slot's lower cap center - the tip rounding is concentric with the slot end, so the arm keeps constant width right to its end. |center| = 70 from C1, on the X axis.
params.note: Rounds the extreme lower-left tip of the arm. Outer extent = 70 + 15 = 85, matching R85 exactly, which confirms concentricity.

params.description: Straight tangent line on the upper-right side of the part, running from the R30 crest over the hub down to the obround's far R8 cap. Parallel to the C1->C3 -45° axis and offset from it to the upper right.
params.offset_confidence: (est) - it is tangent to the R8 far cap, so its perpendicular offset from the -45° centerline is 8 mm on the upper-right side.
params.dimension_reference: The 60 and 30 aligned dimensions are drawn parallel to and outboard of this flank.

params.evidence: The drawing is a single top/plan view. There is no section view, no side view, no leader and no title-block note giving thickness. The only '10' on the sheet is a horizontal LINEAR dimension locating C2 10 mm left of C1 - it is emphatically NOT a thickness. I zoomed to that callout: it has two vertical extension lines and a horizontal dimension line with arrowheads between the C1 and C2 vertical centerlines.
params.recommendation: Keep 10 mm as the working thickness (it is a sensible value for this size of bracket and matches the value already in the model), but flag it as an assumption, not a read dimension.
params.resolution_of_ambiguity_d: Plate thickness is NOT dimensioned on the drawing. Use 10 mm (est). Do not cite the '10' callout as its source.

notes:
SCALE / METHOD: measurements taken from the 474x266 px screenshot, right-hand Paint 3D pane, upscaled up to 18x with Lanczos. Two independent scale calibrations agree: 0.762 mm/px from the Ø40 hub and 0.786 mm/px from the Ø50 boss (3% spread). All derived numbers below were cross-checked against explicit callouts where possible.

RESOLVED AMBIGUITIES:
(a) OUTER PROFILE - It is an open three-lobe (tri-star) closed loop, not a disc. Remove the R50 disc and the arm wedge entirely. Going CCW: R85 arm outer arc (centered at the origin) -> R30 concave valley -> R30 convex crest that rides tangentially over the top of the Ø40 hub -> straight -45° flank -> obround far R8 cap -> obround side -> obround near R8 cap -> R25 concave fillet -> Ø50 boss arc -> R32 concave fillet -> R15 convex arm tip -> back to R85. Every junction is tangent. The Ø40 hub is an isolated ring the boundary passes OVER; it is not a filled disc and its circle is not part of the boundary.
(b) OBROUND (called S2 in the brief) - Axis at -45°. It is the OUTER boundary of the third lobe, not an internal cut. Near cap center (42.426,-42.426) at 60 mm from C1; far cap center (63.64,-63.64) at 90 mm. Cap R8, width 16, cap-to-cap 30, overall length 46. The 135° callout is centered on the far cap and measures from the -X horizontal centerline clockwise to the slot axis (180-45=135).
(c) FILLETS - R85 = arm outer arc, centered at the origin. R30 x2 = the S-curve between the arm and the hub (one concave valley, one convex crest grazing the Ø40 hub). R32 = long concave sweep from the arm's lower tip to the Ø50 boss. R25 = concave fillet from the Ø50 boss to the obround near cap. R15 = convex rounding of the arm's lower-left tip, concentric with the slot's lower cap. R8 x2 = one labels the S1 slot end caps, one labels the obround caps (both are 8).
(d) THICKNESS - Not dimensioned. 10 mm retained as an estimate only.

CORRECTIONS TO THE SUPPLIED CONTEXT (three errors found):
1. S1 slot angular span is 138° to 180°, NOT 117°-159°. Measured 137.1° and 178.9°. The 42° width, R70 centerline, R78/R62 walls and R8 caps are all correct.
2. C3 is at (42.426,-42.426) = 60 mm at -45°, NOT (+46.2,-46.2) which would be 65.34 mm and contradicts the dimensioned 60.
3. C2 is at approximately (-10,-62), NOT (-10,-48.3). The X of -10 is exactly right and is the '10' callout. The Y was measured at -62.1 and -64.1 by two scales and is independently confirmed by the R32 tangency, which reproduces the measured tangent point to within 0.4 mm.

UNREADABLE / NOT PRESENT: no thickness dimension, no title block, no tolerances, no material note, no surface finish, no scale ratio, no part number. The image is a low-resolution desktop screenshot, so all leader arrowhead positions carry roughly +/-1.5 mm of uncertainty; every value asserted as exact above is backed by a legible text callout, and every value I derived is labelled (est).

BUILD ORDER SUGGESTION: 1) sketch the three lobe centers and the two construction rays (-45° to the obround, and the 138°/180° pair for the slot); 2) place the Ø50 boss circle and the obround; 3) draw the R85 arc about the origin; 4) fillet in R15, R32, R25, and the two R30s, letting the solver enforce tangency; 5) trim to the closed loop; 6) extrude 10 mm; 7) cut the Ø20 and Ø16 bores and the R70/42° curved slot.
